title: Special Election by Petition / Local Option Election on Sunday Sales - Ashtabula City 3B
establishment: Laxminarayan Three, L.L.C. dba Convenient Food Mart
sales_type: Wine and mixed beverages on Sunday
plain_english: This local-option question asks voters in the precinct whether one specific store - Convenient Food Mart at 1714 W. 19th Street in Ashtabula - may sell wine and mixed beverages on Sundays under a D-6 liquor permit. Only voters in that precinct decide it.
yes_means: The store is allowed to sell wine and mixed beverages on Sundays.
no_means: Sunday sales of wine and mixed beverages remain prohibited at this store.
